problem_title: Enable/Disable Process Builder Processes all at once
caption:
Enable/Disable Process Builder Processes all at once

🔴 The Problem: BACKGROUND I found this really useful tool called Salesforce Config Switch which allows me to easily enable and disable processes on mass in one go. But it's throwing a 500 error at the moment. QUESTION Are there any other similar tools out there?

✅ The Fix: I wrote a lightning component to allow me to easily enable and disable flows en masse . It lists all the latest Flows, and give you buttons to: Toggle Selected Flows Enable All Flows Disable All Flows Component JavaScript Controller JavaScript Helper Apex Controller SETUP Create Connected App Create Auth. Provider Create Named Credential Create Lightning App Page called Flow Manager
